description: Ran npm install to initialize the project dependencies.
Started the Next.js development server using npm run dev.
Removed Subscription component from app/page.tsx.
Removed 'Subscription' link from src/components/Navbar.tsx.
Deleted src/components/Subscription.tsx.
Created memory.json to track all future changes made to the project.
Listed the project file structure (excluding node_modules and build artifacts).
Formally established memory.json as the 'Brain' of the project. This file serves as the source of truth for project state, structure, and history to ensure consistency and prevent hallucinations.
Rethought the Services section with a premium luxury aesthetic. Implemented a dark theme (#050505), glassmorphism cards (bg-white/[0.03]), gold accents, and dynamic hover effects.

Removed emojis from the Services section and refined icon presentation. Increased icon size to h-12 w-12, added rounded-[2rem] containers, and enhanced glow effects for a cleaner, more professional look.

Upgraded the icons in the Services section to more premium alternatives: Scissors (Barbing), Crown (Braiding), Gem (Nails), and Sparkles (Makeup). Also adjusted gradient colors for better visual distinction.
Removed emojis from all slide titles in the HeroSlider component for a cleaner, more professional presentation.

Reduced the overall size and padding of the Services section for a more compact look. Decreased section padding (py-20), card padding (p-6), heading sizes (text-4xl), icon sizes (h-8), and button padding.
Rethought the 'Our Work' gallery with a premium luxury aesthetic. Implemented a dynamic mosaic grid with varying card sizes, artistic overlays, and a sophisticated lightbox with backdrop blurring.
Redesigned the Hero section buttons with a premium aesthetic. Implemented gold gradients, rounded-full shapes, glassmorphism for the secondary button, and enhanced hover scale/shadow effects.

Refined Hero buttons for better visibility. Simplified the primary button to a solid Tan color and increased the opacity of the secondary glass button (bg-white/25) with a stronger border (border-white/50).

Rethought the 'Who We Are' section with a premium, elegant aesthetic on a white background. Implemented artistic image framing with gold accents, refined Playfair Display typography, and added a features list for better detail.
Reduced the image size in the 'Who We Are' section by 30% by applying max-w-[70%] to its container.
Added a premium Preloader component that shows the logo and a gold loading bar before the main content is displayed. Integrated it into the Home page.
Restored the original colors of the logo in the Preloader by removing CSS filters (grayscale, invert, brightness).
Removed the navigation arrows from the HeroSlider for a cleaner, auto-play only experience.
